## ✨ Added

- **The editor runs under OpenCloud's address.** From version 1.4.0 the [OpenCloud](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/opencloud) container passes Euro Office through its own address at `/euro-office/`, and this image strips that prefix again. The browser only talks to OpenCloud, so OpenCloud's **Office document server URL** is `http://<server-ip>:9900`, the address the WebUI button opens. There is no certificate to accept, and from outside only OpenCloud has to be reachable.

## ⚡ Improved

- The WebUI button opens the start page over http again, and the start page shows that address for OpenCloud.
- The **HTTPS Port** moves back under Advanced View. Only Nextcloud and ownCloud need it, because they load the editor straight from Euro Office.
- The README and the template describe the new route and have their own section for Nextcloud and ownCloud.

## Updating an existing install

Update the OpenCloud container to 1.4.0 as well. The address you entered there keeps working, whether it is `http://<server-ip>:9900` or `https://<server-ip>:9943`.
